script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The passage says Elihu waited to speak, but does not say he was sitting or that he stopped sitting.
The passage does not establish that Elihu has never given Job advice.
The closing line merely repeats that Elihu is angry. It is flat rather than funny.
The passage says Elihu waited because the others were older, but does not say he did so out of respect.
The quick-answer joke has no clear connection to why Elihu waited or to the richer answer.
The explanation repeats that Elihu names the old and not the powerful without adding personality or insight.
The passage does not say whether Elihu is waiting for Job to speak again. It says he has waited while the others spoke.
Elihu promises not to be partial. That is not necessarily the same as promising never to take a side.
